title: Canonical etale pullback on closed-supported sections and its derived map
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $i:C\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of schemes. On the small etale site, define $G_i(F)=\ker(F(X)\to F(X\setminus C))$ for each sheaf $F$ of $A$-modules, with its kernel inclusion $\iota_{i,F}:G_i(F)\to F(X)$, as the module-valued specialization of the kernel-of-restriction construction of [def-pur-support-cohomology]. This is canonically the same kernel functor, with the same inclusion, as the supported-section functor of [def-pur-etale-derived-supported-sections] for the open $i^{\mathrm c}=X\setminus C$. Let $f:Y\to X$ be a scheme morphism and $j:D\hookrightarrow Y$ a closed immersion such that $f^{-1}(i^{\mathrm c})=j^{\mathrm c}$. Let $g_{f,F}:F(X)\to(f^*F)(Y)$ be the usual section pullback: the unit $F\to f_*f^*F$ evaluated on the terminal etale object, followed by its canonical base-change identification with $Y$. Define the ordinary supported pullback $\alpha_f:G_i\to G_j\circ f^*$ to be the unique natural transformation satisfying $\iota_{j,f^*F}\circ\alpha_f(F)=g_{f,F}\circ\iota_{i,F}$ for every $F$. Define its canonical bounded-below derived supported pullback $RG_i\to RG_j\circ f^*$ by right-derived base change of this normalized transformation, where $RG_i$ and $RG_j$ are the ordinary right derived supported-section functors of [def-pur-etale-derived-supported-sections] and the derived $f^*$ is induced by exact inverse image. In particular, for $D=Y\times_X C$ and $j$ its projection to $Y$, the open-complement condition is the canonical equality $f^{-1}(i^{\mathrm c})=j^{\mathrm c}$. No regularity, finiteness, coefficient torsion or affine-line hypothesis is imposed.

def affineSupportDerivedMap (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {C X D Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : C ⟶ X) (j : D ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion j] (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (h : f ⁻¹ᵁ i.openComplement = j.openComplement) :
    (affineSupportKernel A i).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⟶
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⋙
        (affineSupportKernel A j).rightDerivedFunctorPlus
